title: State of the City with Mayor Nancy Backus
topic_titles: []
---

Auburn Parks, Arts & Recreation oversees nearly 1,000 acres of park land and over 20 miles of trails, providing various outdoor activities for residents. The Auburn Farmers Market operates seasonally from June to September at Les Gove Park, offering fresh produce and local goods. The Auburn Community & Event Center hosts a diverse Community Fitness Program featuring numerous classes, an open gym, and a fully equipped weight room to encourage fitness and well-being among community members.

Mayor Nancy Backus will deliver the State of the City address on February 25 at the Muckleshoot Casino Events Center. The event begins at 5 p.m. with a reception, followed by the mayor's address at 6 p.m. Residents are encouraged to reserve free seats by the day prior to the event. The address will provide insights into the city’s developments and future plans.
